parsedVerdict.reasoning: This unit has one file, src/invoice/invoice.service.ts. Most of InvoiceService is about invoices: issue(orderId, amount) creates and saves an InvoiceEntity, and countFor(orderId) counts invoices for an order. The third method, validateCreate(quantity), does not fit. It only forwards to assertCreateRule, which is imported from ../order/order.service. That method checks an order-creation rule based on a quantity. Invoices in this module are described by an amount, not a quantity, so the method has nothing to do with invoices. The rule itself is not copied: it still lives in one place, the order module. But the invoice service now offers order-creation validation as part of its own public API, which mixes an order concern into the invoice module. It also creates a second entry point for an order rule that belongs only to the order module. My confidence is moderate because the method is a thin pass-through rather than a duplicated rule.
